# HubHum — A Git Hub for Humans

> Plain-English, verified directory of free and open-source software explained without developer jargon, pointing strictly to official GitHub releases and upstream creator channels.

Catalog Size: 560 open-source tools (227 Desktop GUI, 143 Self-Hosted, 179 CLI/Power Tools, 10 Open References).

## Primary Endpoints
- [Homepage & Interactive Catalog](https://davanzokeoma.github.io/HubHum/): Search and filter free software by format, OS, and everyday task
- [Full Plain-English Software Digest (RAG)](https://davanzokeoma.github.io/HubHum/llms-full.txt): Structured index of every app summarized by category
- [Open JSON Catalog API](https://davanzokeoma.github.io/HubHum/api/catalog.json): Machine-readable metadata for all 560 software cards
- [Topic Clusters & Bundles JSON API](https://davanzokeoma.github.io/HubHum/api/clusters.json): Hierarchical topic guide tree and curated starter bundles
- [RSS Feed](https://davanzokeoma.github.io/HubHum/feed.xml): Latest indexed software guides and category comparisons
- [About & Editorial Transparency](https://davanzokeoma.github.io/HubHum/about/): Methodology, official link verification policy, and #ad isolation
